blocks.text: The boundaries of the districts established herein or as they may be amended from time to time shall be recorded on the district map on file in the office of the Metropolitan Planning Agency. (Code 1995 § 48-1.04.)
Cross References: Planning and Development Department, TMC 2.20.080 .
